_comment: Copy this file to assets/config/<flavor_key>.json and fill in every REPLACE_ME. This file itself is not a valid flavor (loadAppConfig() is never called with '_template') and json_serializable ignores unknown '_comment' keys, but delete it before shipping a real config to keep things tidy.

copyOverrides._comment: Optional. Only add a key here if THIS brand needs different wording than the shared ARB string for that key, e.g. garage_setup_subtitle. Every key must already exist in packages/core_localization/lib/l10n/intl_<lang>.arb - this does not add new strings, it only rewords existing ones. See docs/white-label-playbook.md.
